content_text: After 18 years of managing Porsche and BMW shops I have gone back to being a working professional still photographer.  Yesterday I was covering a vintage baseball game for my local newspaper, and decided to do some features for myself.  I had in my mind I needed things to look vintage, but I wanted it to be optically done in camera.  I was really inspired by the mindset on The Assassination of Jesse James.   I pulled out my set of tilt shift lenses and kept working the subject matter.  I was also hoping to get an “action” shot that looked like it was done in the old times.  My 90mm tilt shift actually accepted the 1.4 extender I had which allowed for more distortion in the file, but also more reach.  Anyway hope people enjoy seeing what I worked up.
